T2M.definition: The average air (dry bulb) temperature at 2 meters above the surface of the earth.

RH2M.definition: The ratio of vapor pressure to the saturation vapor pressure with respect to a plane surface of pure water, expressed in percent.

WS10M.definition: The average of wind speed at 10 meters above the surface of the earth.

PRECTOTCORR.definition: The average MERRA-2 bias corrected total precipitation at the surface of the earth.

geometry_rule: Country polygon covers native grid centers; half-open boxes; full original native-cell WGS84 quadrilateral area; overlaps retained, no resampling or point proxies
monthly_statistic: Native time mean; PRECTOTCORR mm/day retained; no multiplication by days for feature. Solar Wm-2 converted by 86400/1000000 to MJ/m2/day.
calendar: End-of-month source labels normalized to YYYY-MM; no annual month-13 source in monthly Zarr
source_selection: Meteorology MERRA2 1981-2024; SRB solar 1984-2000; SYN1deg solar 2001-2024, per NASA monthly API source documentation
old_comparison_interpretation: Modern POWER Version 10 ARD regional means vs original API Version 2.9.4 three-point means. Differences combine upstream revisions and correct regional aggregation; no agreement-based selection.
provenance_limitation: Pinned chunk bytes and metadata from this retrieval; dynamic upstream AWS store is not an immutable release. Retrieval headers and per-object SHA256 retained.
